name: Long-cooked Chuck Steak With Vegetables
author: Emilio Müller on based.cooking

ingredients.item: 200 g tomatoes (or 400 g canned chopped tomatoes)

steps: Add a little of the olive oil to the long cooker, put in the meat, and set it to high.
Chop the onion and add it.
Cut the cauliflower to sizes you prefer and add.
Chop or slice 1/3 of the fennel and add.
Crush the tomatoes and add (or add the canned chopped tomatoes).
Add the rest of the olive oil and let it be for at least 6 hours.
Serve with the rest of the fennel (chop or sliced).

culture.text: Vegetables are edible parts of plants that are consumed by humans or other animals as food. This original meaning is still commonly used, and is applied to plants collectively to refer to all edible plant matter, including flowers, fruits, stems, leaves, roots, and seeds. An alternative definition is applied somewhat arbitrarily, often by culinary and cultural tradition; it may include savoury fruits such as tomatoes and squash, flowers such as broccoli, and seeds such as pulses, but exclude foods derived from some plants that are fruits, flowers, nuts, and cereal grains.
